description: M2.5 micro reactor defense WIN path. Player digs the floor near spawn to satisfy the M2.5 'use chunked terrain' contract (terrain.terrain_carved count >= 1) WITHOUT touching the dirt shield mound that protects the reactor. Player then idles for the rest of the timer; the dirt shield blocks every guard projectile, the reactor survives, mission resolves to mission.result=won + objective.defend_reactor=completed.
